credit: NISAR L2 GCOV, NASA/JPL-Caltech and ISRO, via ASF DAAC (NASA Earthdata)
definition: event HH minus baseline HH, dB (baseline = mean of 2026-10-04 and 2026-10-16 in linear power; 3 x 3 smoothed in linear power; land only)

ramp.name: blue-white-orange (colour-blind safe)
ramp.p99_basis: valid non-permanent-water pixels of this date

sigma.source: robust (MAD) sigma of the normal-fortnight difference, 16 Oct minus 4 Oct, HH, over land (docs/METHODS.md step 6)
sigma.note: the event-minus-baseline difference uses a two-date mean baseline, so its true noise is a little smaller: 1 sigma is a cautious grey band

grey.label: no clear change
grey.rule: pixels with |change| < 1 sigma are drawn grey, not coloured

ramp.note: negative = darker than the reference, positive = brighter; white = no change; grey = change smaller than 1 sigma of normal variation

note: difference of calibrated backscatter on the class grid; negative = darker (e.g. new open water), positive = brighter. Not a flood map by itself.
